_comment: The 7 coupons (Coupon Cards, Thank-You Page & Email Copy Guide). Used by the coupons page, the claim pop-up, the thank-you page (lib/coupons.ts) and the coupon email (public/send-coupons.php), so edit offers here only. Set expires to null for no expiration. group: winter (red, top row), winter-driving (red, middle row), evergreen (yellow, bottom row).

coupons.title: Winter Safety Check
coupons.label: Winter Safety Check ($49.95)
coupons.detail: Battery & charging system test, coolant freeze protection test, brake & tire inspection, wheel alignment check, heating/defrost check, wipers/lights/belts/hoses check, tire rotation & balance, and complete Digital Vehicle Inspection (DVI). Save $40.00 (regularly $89.95). Get this deal by December 30, 2026.
coupons.terms: Inspection, rotation & balance package; oil change not included.
coupons.booking: In the booking menu, select "Winter Safety Check ($49.95)".

coupons.title: Complete Winter Package
coupons.label: Complete Winter Package ($99.99)
coupons.detail: Everything in the Winter Safety Package, PLUS full synthetic oil & filter change (up to 5 quarts), tire rotation, fluid level check & basic top-off, and engine/cabin air filter inspection. Save $30.00 (regularly $129.99). Get this deal by December 30, 2026.
coupons.terms: Up to 5 quarts full synthetic oil; extra quarts & specialty filters additional.
coupons.booking: In the booking menu, select "Complete Winter Package ($99.99)".

coupons.title: Wheel Alignment Special
coupons.label: Wheel Alignment Special ($50 Off)
coupons.detail: Save $50.00 on a precision 4-wheel alignment for most passenger cars. Protect your tires and improve winter road handling.
coupons.terms: Valid for most passenger vehicles. Cannot be combined with other offers.
coupons.booking: Book the standard "Alignments" service and show this coupon at check-in.

coupons.title: VA State Safety Inspection
coupons.label: VA State Safety Inspection ($5 Off)
coupons.detail: Save $5.00 on your Virginia State Safety Inspection. Beat the end-of-the-month rush—walk-ins welcome Monday–Saturday!
coupons.terms: Applies to combined VA state Safety inspection visits.
coupons.booking: Book the standard "Safety Inspection" service and show this coupon at check-in.

coupons.title: First Visit
coupons.label: First Visit ($25 Off, Min. $150)
coupons.detail: Save $25.00 on your first visit at Duke Auto Repair & Service (minimum $150.00 service required).
coupons.terms: New customers only; minimum $150 service before tax. Cannot be combined with other offers.
coupons.booking: Book the repair or maintenance service you need and show this coupon at check-in.
